ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white/mottled pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling and stippling concentrated on the distal halves of both the left and right lobes; central region and peduncle interface remain solid black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression with an approximate 110-degree vertex angle; depth is approximately 4% of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Dense, high-frequency serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing boundary, with a significant jagged protrusion and irregular tissue mass on the far right tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex leading edge with a moderate concave sweep on the trailing edges from tips to center.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several distinct circular white rings visible: two stacked vertically on the distal left lobe, and one prominent ring on the distal right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct vertical white linear marks in the lower-central right lobe area and one diagonal scratch through the mottled region on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large cluster of barnacle colonization on the far right tip and smaller colonies on the far left tip; irregular trailing edge on the right tip suggests past tissue trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized bio-fouling (barnacles) creating significant textural and color variance at the extreme distal points of the fluke lobes.
